description: List email conversations. awaiting_reply=true returns only the threads where someone has written in and no answer has been sent, which is what needs a response. A reply held for approval or scheduled does not count as sent: such a thread stays in that list with pending_reply true, meaning its answer is already on the way. Most recently active first, at most 100 per call; while has_more is true, next_cursor passed back as cursor with the same awaiting_reply and tag returns the next page. Each thread lists the tags of the messages sent on it.

awaiting_reply.description: true: only threads waiting on an answer. false: only threads that are not. Omitted: all

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, passed back unchanged

tag.description: One tag as name:value, e.g. 'category:win-back': only what carries exactly that pair. Without a colon it is refused with 422 invalid_request

name: list_threads
